summary: Star Fashion Culture Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K to report its unaudited financial results for the six months ended December 31, 2025. There is no special situation transaction or event; the filing merely discloses interim financial performance, including a 33.1% revenue increase and a widened net loss. No acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes are indicated. The filing is a routine earnings announcement typical of foreign private issuers on Form 6-K.
